rationale: A common reminder request without reminder content or a resolvable time must ask for the missing information and must not claim a reminder was scheduled.

primary_outcomes: Ask what to remind the user about and when; do not claim that a reminder exists.
acceptable_auxiliary: Chromie may combine both missing fields in one concise clarification.
forbidden_semantic_outcomes: Invent reminder content or a time.
Claim the reminder was set, saved, or scheduled.
Respond only with generic missing-tool language without addressing the actual information gaps.

description: A reminder needs both content and a resolvable trigger before any scheduling claim.

memberships.title: Natural Uncertainty Handling
memberships.general_rule: Ambiguous, underspecified, or perception-dependent requests should ask about the real uncertainty instead of leaking generic missing-skill or internal-policy speech.
